name: Ashling
description: Ashling is a female flamekin pilgrim from Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, the last flamekin born at Mount Tanufel, who became the Destroyer in Shadowmoor and later atoned.

summary.text: Ashling is a female flamekin pilgrim from Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, the last flamekin born at Mount Tanufel, who became the Destroyer in Shadowmoor and later atoned.

bio.text: She began a pilgrimage through Lorwyn searching for the greater elemental of her birth and took a messenger job from Colfenor to reach Rhys.

citations.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Brigid, manipulated by Colfenor's message, nearly drowned her, and the greater elemental rekindled her fire, which set Colfenor ablaze.

citations.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She climbed Mount Tanufel, resolved to claim the elemental's power for herself, and at the Great Aurora ritual seized the elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force.

citations.text: "Ashling", section "The Ember Fell Monastery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ashling", section "The Ember Fell Monastery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ashling", section "Destiny fulfilled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In Shadowmoor she became the Extinguisher, called the Destroyer, and laid waste to many places but was repelled from Mistmeadow and Kinscaer.

citations.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Maralen, Brigid, Captain Sygg and the Source of the Wanderbrine subdued her, and reduced to a flamekin again she repented and helped destroy Oona.

citations.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Later she became a rimekin in Shadowmoor, keeping her memory, and in Lorwyn Eclipsed she joined Maralen's party against the elves' plot to kill the night beast.

citations.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

citations.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citations.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

bio.text: She departed the Blessed Nation at the start of the Pendulum Year to reconcile her two selves and discover the fourth path.

citations.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

status.text: Ashling is alive, having left the Blessed Nation to reconcile her flamekin and rimekin selves.

citations.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Ashling begins a pilgrimage through Lorwyn, searching for the greater elemental of her birth.
timeline.quote: In 4520 AR , Ashling journeyed on a pilgrimage through Lorwyn

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling takes a messenger job from Colfenor, gains the Vendilion clique and Brigid Baeli as companions at Kinsbaile.
timeline.quote: Ashling had accepted a seemingly innocuous messenger job from the treefolk sage Colfenor

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling meets Rhys and Maralen, who is later revealed to be a fae duplicate bearing a piece of Oona's soul.
timeline.quote: Maralen was a fae duplicate

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Festival of Tales Gilt-Leaf soldiers ambush the party; Ashling repels the arrows with fire.
timeline.quote: Ashling protected her new friends valiantly

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid drenches Ashling, nearly killing her; the greater elemental appears, rekindles her fire and sets Colfenor ablaze.
timeline.quote: A surge of energy from the elemental's blessing rekindled her fire and set Colfenor ablaze, obliterating the yew.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Pilgrimage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gaddock Teeg assigns Brigid to accompany Ashling in finding the Gilt-Leaf elf Rhys.
timeline.quote: Brigid became embroiled in an increasingly complex adventure when Gaddock Teeg assigned her to accompany a flamekin messenger named Ashling on her mission to find a Gilt-Leaf elf named Rhys .

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Manipulated by Colfenor's message, Brigid nearly drowns Ashling and attacks Rhys at the Murmuring Bosk.
timeline.quote: Brigid nearly drowned Ashling on the banks of the Murmuring Bosk to snuff out her fire, attacked Rhys, and escaped to Kinsbaile with an unconscious, dying Ashling in tow.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unexpected adventure". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teeg dies in flames as Colfenor combusts, though Ashling is saved.
timeline.quote: as he would eventually be set ablaze and die as Colfenor dramatically combusted by way of his own machinations.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "A new legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid lives in Mistmeadow and helps defend it from Ashling the Destroyer.
timeline.quote: Later, Brigid came to live in Mistmeadow and helped to defend the city from Ashling the Destroyer.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vigilant Eidren sacrifices himself to hurl Ashling away and save Mistmeadow.
timeline.quote: Mistmeadow was saved only by the sacrifice of Vigilant Eidren, who channeled the power of the Wilt-Leaf forest through his body directly at Ashling and hurled her away.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen takes Ashling's elemental power, then betrays Brigid above Cayr Ulios.
timeline.quote: Maralen snapped the Crescent from Brigid's neck and sent her falling.

citation.text: "Brigid Baeli", section "An unfamiliar world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane into Shadowmoor, a coalition including Maralen and Rhys defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys

citation.text: "Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Age of Oona". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An arbomander attacks Sygg's ferry, knocking him out and eating Dugah; the faeries save the passengers.
timeline.quote: Sygg was knocked unconscious, Dugah was eaten

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Vendilion clique abducts Maralen; Sygg reaches the Bosk with Rhys, Ashling and Brigid.
timeline.quote: Sygg took the company through the Dark Meanders

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid attacks Ashling, ensnares Sygg and Rhys in a net, and Sygg frees them with acid.
timeline.quote: Sygg managed to free them both from the kithkin hero's trap

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The triplets meet Ashling on a ferry and save the passengers from an arbomander.
timeline.quote: They saved her and the other passengers when the ferry was attacked by an arbomander

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Assignment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling ascends a step on the Path of Flame, able to will her flame white, and leaves in flame with the elemental after helping free the giants.
timeline.quote: she also ascended a step on the Path of Flame, being able to will her red flame to a white one

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Abused and angry". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling resolves to claim the elemental's power for herself rather than seek its guidance.
timeline.quote: instead to claim its power, fully, for herself

citation.text: "Ashling", section "The Ember Fell Monastery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling climbs Mount Tanufel, meets monks of the Ember Fell monastery and joins forces with Colfenor's sapling.
timeline.quote: The two joined forces to complete one of the tests set for Ashling by the monks.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "The Ember Fell Monastery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling, Brigid and the Vendilion clique find Rhys with a message from Colfenor.
timeline.quote: the flamekin carried a message for him

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid, manipulated by Colfenor, lies about Ashling and Sygg and escapes to Kinsbaile with Ashling.
timeline.quote: Brigid, who was manipulated into the act by Colfenor, escaped to Kinsbaile with Ashling.

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Siring the Sapling". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling is rekindled by a greater elemental and Colfenor burns to death as planned, promising to see Rhys again.
timeline.quote: the rekindling of Ashling by a greater elemental that she was seeking and the fiery demise of Colfenor

citation.text: "Rhys", section "The master and the mentor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Endry's mushroom ring lets Maralen divert energy from Ashling's ritual.
timeline.quote: Endry's mushroom faerie ring planted at the sapling's body allowed Maralen to divert a part of the energy from Ashling's ritual for herself.

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Ember Fell trial Ashling restores fire to ghostly flamekin and learns she is meant to be a vessel for the flamekin fire.
timeline.quote: a vessel to bring the flamekin fire through the shadowy future

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Destiny fulfilled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Great Aurora ritual Ashling seizes the elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force, absorbing them; some energy goes to Maralen.
timeline.quote: she seized the unsuspecting elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Destiny fulfilled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lorwyn gives way to Shadowmoor and Ashling becomes one of its mightiest beings.
timeline.quote: Lorwyn gave place to the dreadful Shadowmoor, with Ashling becoming one of the mightiest beings on it.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Destiny fulfilled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Shadowmoor Ashling becomes the Extinguisher, called the Destroyer, worshiped and scorned by the cinders.
timeline.quote: Ashling became the Extinguisher , also known as the "Destroyer" to the other races.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling lays waste to many places but is repelled from Mistmeadow and Kinscaer.
timeline.quote: Ashling laid waste to many places in Shadowmoor.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Brigid, Captain Sygg and the Source of the Wanderbrine subdue the Destroyer; Maralen gains the elemental power instead of Oona.
timeline.quote: but Maralen, aided by the scroll of Rosheen Meanderer , gained the power instead

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Reduced to a flamekin again, Ashling repents and helps Maralen's party defeat and destroy Oona.
timeline.quote: repented for her actions and tried to atone by helping Maralen's party defeat and destroy Oona

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Advent of the Destroyer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Colfenor meets Gaddock Teeg and retains Ashling to reach Rhys, while Oona's Vendilion clique spies on him.
timeline.quote: Colfenor tasked Ashling with reaching his former apprentice, Rhys.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Colfenor and Rhys reunite in Kinsbaile, and Colfenor sends him to plant his seed cone at Murmuring Bosk.
timeline.quote: Colfenor tasked Rhys with traveling to Murmuring Bosk

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys, Ashling and Brigid find Murmuring Bosk leveled and burned, and Rhys plants the cone anyway.
timeline.quote: Rhys planted the cone anyway, performing a ritual to ensure its growth.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Colfenor learns Brigid was meant to capture Rhys and redirects her to abduct Ashling so as to end his own life.
timeline.quote: Colfenor covertly redirected Brigid to abduct Ashling instead.

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling is rekindled by a greater elemental and her fire engulfs Colfenor, who dies as the last yew despite Rhys's efforts.
timeline.quote: the last yew burned brightly to his death

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Reunion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Colfenor's sapling rises one day after his death, greeting the company as her seedfather's heir.
timeline.quote: the young tree had grown, awakened, and "risen" merely one day after Colfenor's death

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gryffid's troops ambush Rhys, the Sapling and Ashling; Rhys talks him out of attacking and Gryffid hurries to protect Cayr Ulios.
timeline.quote: Rhys talked Gryffid out of attacking

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona tries to take Ashling's elemental power but is thwarted by Maralen, Brigid Baeli and Sygg, then retreats to Cayr Ulios and drains the elves.
timeline.quote: She tried to take the elemental power of Ashling , but was thwarted by Maralen

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated at Glen Elendra with the sacrifice of the Sapling of Colfenor and the combined power of Maralen and Ashling's elemental; Maralen becomes queen of the fae as day returns.
timeline.quote: Maralen took her place as queen of the fae as day returned to the plane.

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sygg helps Maralen and Brigid ambush Ashling; Maralen betrays him and keeps the Crescent.
timeline.quote: She kept the Crescent and united the power of two greater elementals, fire and water, in herself.

citation.text: "Sygg Gauhren Gyllalla Syllvar", section "After the Great Aurora". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Around 4522 Ashling ventures to the Primal Beyond to better understand the plane's duality.
timeline.quote: Around 4522, she ventured to the Primal Beyond at the edge of Lorwyn

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling, now free of her Destroyer persona, becomes a rimekin in Shadowmoor and can keep those near her in Lorwyn form.
timeline.quote: she now became a rimekin when entering Shadowmoor

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen seeks Ashling's help as Oona's consciousness reasserts itself, bringing news of Isilu and Morcant's plot; they travel to Goldmeadow.
timeline.quote: Ashling was approached by Maralen in her time of crisis

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling and the others fight the Shadowmoor-afflicted kithkin and Gilt-Leaf elves; Rhys catches Maralen and fatally strikes her as their pact demanded.
timeline.quote: Rhys managed to catch up to Maralen and fatally struck her just as their pact had demanded of him.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eirdu and Isilu reunite, rebalancing the plane's cycle; Rhys, freed of the pact's magic, dissolves into Eirdu's light.
timeline.quote: Ashling then watched as he dissolved into Eirdu's light.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "An unchanged heart". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen steals Ashling's power with the scroll and Crescent and challenges Oona.
timeline.quote: Maralen succeeded in temporarily stealing Ashling’s power for herself.

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashling regains her power and sanity and joins Rhys against Oona.
timeline.quote: Restored to herself, Ashling joined Rhys in a final assault against Oona.

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Vendilion clique, the elven monarchs and countless fae and elves perish; Ashling is freed of her madness and Maralen becomes queen of the fae.
timeline.quote: Maralen stood triumphant as the world's new queen of the fae.

citation.text: "Fusion of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen manipulates Endry into planting a faerie ring on the sapling to siphon the power of Ashling's ritual.
timeline.quote: She had manipulated Endry into planting a faerie ring of mushrooms on the sapling

citation.text: "Maralen", section "The thorn princess". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen, with Rhys, Ashling and two elementals, destroys Oona and becomes queen of the fae.
timeline.quote: Oona was destroyed and wiped from the face of Lorwyn.

citation.text: "Maralen", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oona is defeated by Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor's sapling, though her consciousness survives.
timeline.quote: Though Oona was defeated and her body was destroyed, her consciousness remains hidden

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Oona's defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oko cures Maralen with dawnglow; Eirdu appears to offset Isilu and Rhys is at peace.
timeline.quote: Oko acquired a vial of dawnglow

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Last task". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Rhys and Ashling destroy Oona.
timeline.quote: destroyed Oona by a combination of poison, fire, and water magic.

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Disbanding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The group finds Ashling at the Stinkdrinker warren and sets out to track Isilu, but is halted by Brigid and the Shadowmoor kithkin.
timeline.quote: The four set out to track down Isilu

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lorwyn elves attack Isilu, kithkin join the fight, and Maralen and Tamira are poisoned with moonglow.
timeline.quote: Maralen and Tamira were injured with the deadly poison moonglow

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Great Aurora turns the plane to Shadowmoor, a coalition of Maralen, Rhys, Brigid, Sygg, Ashling and Colfenor defeats Oona.
timeline.quote: Oona was defeated by a coalition consisting of Maralen, an elf named Rhys, a kithkin named Brigid, a merrow named Sygg, a flamekin named Ashling, and a treefolk sapling named Colfenor.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson, DK Billins, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Sep 2025.

timeline.summary: The coracle reaches the Stinkdrinker Warren, where Ashling pulls Maralen ashore.
timeline.quote: A four-fingered hand made of what looked like flexible black glass caught her wrist and tugged her onto solid ground.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen tells Ashling their story, and Ashling reveals the elves and Morcant plan to kill the night beast with poisons.
timeline.quote: They're concocting a plan to kill the creature.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen rejects ending the night forever, saying eternal day is Oona's way, and Ashling agrees to help stop the elves.
timeline.quote: Eternal day is Oona's way, not my own.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Maralen, Tam, Sanar and Ashling set out down the Wanderwine in a boggart-crewed boat, and Maralen tells of Oona's great aurora.
timeline.quote: she managed to capture the auroras that naturally flare between night and day and braid them into a single great aurora

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Shadowmoor claims the Wanderwine and the boggarts refuse to go farther, forcing the group to walk.
timeline.quote: Shadowmoor had taken the Wanderwine.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ashling steps into Shadowmoor and becomes rimekin, retaining her memory.
timeline.quote: By night, I'm what we call 'rimekin,'

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The transformed kithkin of Goldmeadow led by Brigid surround and herd the party.
timeline.quote: the transformed Brigid at the front of their pack.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 5: If We Shadows" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Elves advance on Maralen's party as the kithkin form a united wall and Isilu draws near with the faerie.
timeline.quote: The night-touched kithkin continued to ready their weapons and adjust their positions

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Isilu lowers its head to Ashling and begins circling the party protectively against the elves.
timeline.quote: It's protecting us,

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ashling reveals the elf torches hold captive sunlight elementals.
timeline.quote: Chained and captive and carried into night.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: A disarmed elf becomes a Shadowmoor elf and defects, prompting Brigid and the kithkin to charge.
timeline.quote: Brigid seemed to take her defection as a cue

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 6: Full of Hateful Fantasies" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ashling departs the Blessed Nation at the start of the Pendulum Year to reconcile her two selves and discover the fourth path.
timeline.quote: At the beginning of the Pendulum Year, she departed the Blessed Nation

citation.text: "The Legends of Lorwyn Eclipsed" by Neale LaPlante Johnson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2026.

timeline.summary: Rhys, Maralen and Ashling free the giants from the nettlevines.
timeline.quote: This was prevented by Rhys, Maralen , and Ashling

citation.text: "Brion Stoutarm", section "Once more in Rhys' service". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In Shadowmoor, Eidren used his body as a conduit of forest magic to hurl Ashling away from Mistmeadow, destroying himself.
timeline.quote: the flux of magic force destroyed Eidren's body in the process

citation.text: "Eidren", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid fights Ashling in the Murmuring Bosk and lies to Rhys.
timeline.quote: the kithkin hero lied to Rhys that Ashling had gone mad

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A greater elemental reignites Ashling, costing Colfenor and Teeg their lives.
timeline.quote: This came at the cost of both Colfenor's and Cenn Teeg's lives

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brigid and Rhys join forces to rescue Ashling.
timeline.quote: Brigid and Rhys decided to join forces

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Colfenor hires Ashling through Teeg to reunite him with Rhys.
timeline.quote: Through Teeg, Colfenor hired the flamekin messenger Ashling

citation.text: "Gaddock Teeg", section "Political suicide". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
